promotion_gap_flag.detail: The carried engine/promote_official.py results cross-check compares (away_pts, home_pts) against every independent record found in data/raw/official_results_<date>.json and data/official/results_<date>.json. data/official/results_2026-11-15.json (owner: session arena/8f64e94c-nba1, out of this session's scope) still carries away_pts/home_pts = null for games that were in progress at its retrieval time and are final now, and its rows overwrite the raw cross file in the promoter's merge order - so a capture containing the four new finals would fail-closed with 'disagrees with independent record None-None'. Nothing was appended to data/raw/games_completed.json this session; no gate was loosened and no out-of-scope file was edited. The verified finals above are recorded here as first-hand evidence, ready for promotion once the independent record is refreshed (its owner) or the promoter gains a null-aware rule (engine owner).
